text_block_list.text: —The final day of summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――
choice_data_list:
That's the entire workout menu 
finished...!
That's the whole training menu done...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good work, Journey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Truly... it has been a wonderful summer, 
hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Yes. ...Even I can tell."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Without the help of everyone in the Mejiro 
family, I never could have made it this 
far before the summer ended—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To repay this great favor... I will first 
prove myself with results in the Kikuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...I shall be looking forward to it.
That night—

Unable to sleep from a strange surge of 
excitement, I went out to catch the sea 
breeze, and—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —...Can you not sleep?

"Could she be feeling the same way?" I was 
about to ask, but stopped myself.
A smoky aroma tickles my nostrils.

...It felt faintly lighter than what 
usually drifted from her.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: You look a little happy right now.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Until this day, you have fought 
desperately to carve out a viable path 
forward for your 'journey.'"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Hungry to absorb all the knowledge and 
experience the Mejiro family possesses and 
turn it into strength—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why you look forward to 
it so much, and why your heart races, 
isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I want to show everyone how I'll run from 
now on as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Look, she seems happy.
choice_data_list: I was... smiling just now, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: So beautifully.

...The night is carved into the sky. 
Whether there is a path to seek, or none 
at all.
And—
...Morning shines brightly.
As if to point beyond the shroud of night—
